description: Reagents stored at FMARS over winter were far outside their specified storage temperature range (15-30 degrees C vs. Arctic winter at -55 degrees C). Coliform powder had solidified and pH strip reliability was uncertain.
response: The crew tested all reagents with controls before use. Results were treated with appropriate uncertainty. Coliform powder was recovered with vigorous agitation.
lesson: Do not rely on on-site reagents for safety-critical or publication-quality measurements. Bring all critical reagents from home in temperature-protected packaging. Always run controls before use.
pattern_tag: reagent storage temperature exposure over winter
